# Weapon Slash - Effect

- Source: https://opengameart.org/content/weapon-slash-effect
- Author: Cethiel
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain)
- Downloaded: 2026-08-11

`Everything_0.zip` is preserved with the original PNG frame sequences. The
included source frames have a visible solid-color backing, so they are kept as
reference material and are not used at runtime. The game uses transparent
effects for impacts and a procedural swing arc for the melee animation.
